CLL_SLL.name: Chronic lymphocytic leukaemia / small lymphocytic lymphoma

heme_involvement_pattern.primary_compartment: peripheral_blood + bone_marrow + lymph_nodes + spleen (CLL is the leukaemic presentation; SLL is nodal-predominant, same disease)

biomarkers.name: Immunophenotype (CD5+, CD19+, CD23+, dim CD20/CD22/sIg, CD200+)
biomarkers.clinical_use: Distinguishes CLL from other small B-cell lymphomas (mantle cell CD5+ but typically CD23- and cyclin D1+/t(11;14))

biomarkers.name: IGHV mutation status
biomarkers.clinical_use: Unmutated IGHV: shorter time to treatment, worse outcomes on chemoimmunotherapy — but BTK/BCL2 inhibitor-based therapy reduces much of this difference

biomarkers.name: del(17p) / TP53
biomarkers.prevalence: ~5-10% at diagnosis; increases with relapsed/refractory disease (~20-40%)
biomarkers.clinical_use: Most adverse biomarker category. Chemoimmunotherapy NOT recommended. Targeted therapy (BTK inhibitors — ibrutinib, acalabrutinib, zanubrutinib; venetoclax-based therapy) preferred

biomarkers.name: del(11q) / ATM
biomarkers.clinical_use: Historically adverse; associated with bulky lymphadenopathy

biomarkers.name: BTK / PLCG2 mutations
biomarkers.prevalence: Acquired resistance to covalent BTK inhibitors
biomarkers.clinical_use: BTK C481 substitutions: resistance to covalent BTK inhibitors; consider non-covalent BTK inhibitor (e.g. pirtobrutinib) or venetoclax-based therapy. PLCG2: downstream resistance mechanism

biomarkers.name: BCL2
biomarkers.clinical_use: Therapeutic target for venetoclax; venetoclax + obinutuzumab (CLL14) is a fixed-duration first-line regimen

biomarkers.name: MRD (flow cytometry, high-throughput sequencing)
biomarkers.prevalence: Established prognostic biomarker in modern trials; not routinely required to direct standard care in all settings
biomarkers.clinical_use: Undetectable MRD (uMRD), usually defined at 10^-4 sensitivity, after venetoclax-based combinations is associated with improved PFS in trials such as MURANO and CLL14

biomarkers.name: Karnofsky / CIRS (comorbidity assessment)
biomarkers.clinical_use: Comorbidity/fitness stratification for treatment choice, especially in older studies and some current regimen selection

biomarkers.name: NOTCH1 / SF3B1 / BIRC3
biomarkers.prevalence: Recurrent subclonal drivers: NOTCH1 ~10-15%, SF3B1 ~10-20%, BIRC3 ~3-5% at diagnosis
biomarkers.clinical_use: Associated with adverse biology/prognosis; NOTCH1 may predict reduced benefit from anti-CD20 type 1 antibodies in chemoimmunotherapy settings

histomorphological_subtype.primary_pattern: Small mature-appearing lymphocytes with clumped chromatin ('soccer ball' or 'billiard ball' pattern) in peripheral blood; proliferation centres (pseudofollicles) in involved lymph nodes
variants: CLL (leukaemic presentation with lymphocytosis ≥5×10^9/L monoclonal B cells)
SLL (nodal-predominant with same immunophenotype but without absolute lymphocytosis)
histomorphological_subtype.grading: Rai and Binet clinical staging; not morphologically graded

tumor_microenvironment.immune_context: Immunosuppressive (hypogammaglobulinaemia, T-cell dysfunction, autoimmune complications). BCL2 dependence underlies venetoclax activity. BTK inhibitors disrupt B-cell receptor signalling and microenvironmental support
tumor_microenvironment.stromal_features: Proliferation centres (pseudofollicles with prolymphocytes and paraimmunoblasts) in involved nodes; classic 'proliferation centre' architecture

cellular_states_and_lineage.cell_of_origin: Mature B cells with antigen-experienced phenotype; IGHV-mutated CLL is generally linked to post-germinal-centre memory B-cell-like origin (better prognosis), whereas IGHV-unmutated CLL is linked to naive/pre-germinal-centre-like B cells (worse prognosis)
cellular_states_and_lineage.differentiation_state: Mature small B cells with characteristic immunophenotype (CD5+, CD19+, CD20 dim, CD23+, sIg dim) — recapitulates memory B-cell-like (IGHV-mutated) or naive-like (IGHV-unmutated) phenotype
cellular_states_and_lineage.lineage_plasticity: IGHV mutation status reflects cell-of-origin biology and prognosis; Richter transformation to DLBCL (~2-10%) represents clonal evolution, often with TP53 disruption, CDKN2A/B loss, NOTCH1 activation and/or MYC alterations; rare transformation to Hodgkin-variant Richter
